scope: One new P06 accepted test and two helpers; independent read-only review

findings.title: Attempt owned unpause even when finally inspection fails
findings.counterexample: Exact owned PG accepts pause; pause response is lost (or outage assertion fails); subsequent finally inspect raises a transient Docker transport error. Short-circuit condition exits exceptionally before unpauseContainerCmd is reached. The container can remain paused and post-finally recovery/state oracles never run.
findings.required_correction: Keep exact fixture ownership and baseline-unpaused check; ensure an unpause attempt is made after an attempted pause even when cleanup inspection is unavailable, while preserving/reporting cleanup failure and the original test failure. Do not silently swallow failure or broaden targets.
findings.evidence: Selected source finally condition verified; pure-RAM logical transcription confirms inspect exception yields zero unpause attempts. Actual Docker transport not executed.

oracle_assessment.real_outage: Meaningful: exact non-reusable POSTGRES container paused and inspected; same otherwise-valid B takes production controller/admission/JDBC path to 503 AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE/no-store/no internalToken; correct B JTI refresh returns AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE. No mocked outage seam.
oracle_assessment.state_and_recovery: Meaningful conditional on cleanup: after unpause, retained B positive and A exact negative, RAM equality of both own session tuples including current/previous JTI/version/revoke/expiry/timestamps/labels, own exact event rows and rolesVersion, and global auth_outbox count; prior correct B JTI still rotates after equality.
oracle_assessment.clock_and_freshness: Access tokens 300s, refresh absolute 86400s, checkedAt=now+2s fixed service clock; same 60s internal TTL. Method timeout60 and local connect/socket timeout2s bound normal JDBC failure. JWT library parser uses wall clock; compile/runtime timeout/cleanup behavior remains unproved.
oracle_assessment.old_assertions: Exact inverse of two insertions restores baseline old bytes; imports/defaults/assertions unchanged.
oracle_assessment.privacy: New explicit checks use booleans for identities/claims/state and print no token/body/JTI/key. No private files/logs/XML/environment read. Future failed JUnit/Gradle artifacts remain private and need existing closed collection.
oracle_assessment.limitations: Reconstruction is not full OS Auth process restart. Production controller under standalone MockMvc is not real Gateway/PWA/TMA. One active STUDENT/group does not establish LIMITED/all-role behavior/full P06.

sensitivity.expected_causal_failure: Healthy A/B and reconstruction controls are unaffected. Actual paused-PG snapshot returns JDBC AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE, then mutated mapping returns INVALID_SESSION; GlobalExceptionHandler maps this to 401, so line275/helper1340 expected503 fails. This distinguishes dependency unavailability from authentication rejection.
